findings.description: The Lambda environment variables embed an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform configuration. These credentials can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, and Lambda configuration access, enabling unauthorized AWS API access if valid.

The function uses Node.js 12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the Lambda execution environment or dependencies.
